:::{#def-quantile-function}
#### Quantile function (population inverse CDF)

For a random variable $X$
with [cumulative distribution function (CDF)](#def-cdf) $\cdf$,
its population **quantile function**
(generalized inverse of $\cdf$)
is [@wikipedia_quantile_function]:

$$\quantilef{p} \eqdef \inf \set{t : \cdff{t} \ge p}, \quad p \in (0, 1).$$

:::
